root_cause.text: The zram discard path in `zram_bio_discard()` had an early return for unsupported partial discard requests that bypassed `bio_endio()`, leaving the `bio` completion unfinished and causing waiters to hang.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (n <= (PAGE_SIZE - offset)) return;` to `goto end_bio;` and adds the shared `end_bio:` path calling `bio_endio(bio)`, while the CVE/commit message explicitly states that zram “returns immediately” for partial discards and “forget[s] to endio,” so `blkdiscard` “sleeps forever in submit_bio_wait()`.”

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `if (n <= (PAGE_SIZE - offset)) return;` to `goto end_bio;` and adds the shared `end_bio:` path calling `bio_endio(bio)`, while the CVE/commit message explicitly states that zram “returns immediately” for partial discards and “forget[s] to endio,” so `blkdiscard` “sleeps forever in submit_bio_wait()`.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix zram discard handling so short offset-contained discards complete through the normal bio end path instead of returning early.
intent_record.what: In zram_bio_discard(), the statement inside the `if (offset)` block for the condition `if (n <= (PAGE_SIZE - offset))` was changed from `return;` to `goto end_bio;`.
intent_record.how: Instead of exiting the function immediately when the discard range fits within the remainder of the current page, execution now jumps to the `end_bio` cleanup/completion path, ensuring the bio is properly finalized rather than returning early without completion handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a common `end_bio` label before `bio_endio(bio)` in `zram_bio_discard()` to support shared exit flow for bio completion.
intent_record.what: A label named `end_bio:` was inserted immediately before the existing `bio_endio(bio);` call at the end of `zram_bio_discard()`.
intent_record.how: This does not change behavior by itself, but it creates a jump target so other code paths in the function can branch directly to the common bio completion call instead of duplicating or bypassing it.

grouping_result.intent: Fix zram discard handling so short offset-contained discards complete through the normal bio end path instead of returning early.
Add a common `end_bio` label before `bio_endio(bio)` in `zram_bio_discard()` to support shared exit flow for bio completion.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it fixes the zram discard path so unsupported partial/short discards no longer return early and instead complete via the normal bio end path, ensuring bio_endio() is reached.
The change introduces a shared exit path ending in bio_endio(bio) within zram_bio_discard(), which directly addresses the root cause of early returns skipping bio completion and causing hangs.

candidates.rationale: This early return exits zram_bio_discard() for a partial discard contained within the initial page, bypassing the normal bio completion path and preventing bio_endio(bio) from being called, which can leave waiters hanging.
This conditional identifies the unsupported short partial-discard case and directly guards the buggy early return path that skips bio completion.

vuln_statements.explanation: This early return exits zram_bio_discard() on the unsupported partial-discard case before reaching the normal completion path, so bio_endio(bio) is not called and waiters can hang.
This condition selects the short offset-contained partial discard case that triggers the buggy early return path, making it the control-flow guard for the incomplete bio completion vulnerability.
